study.text: Hindsight check (one-off study, Nov 2026): picking the sector winners with only the first year of data (Nov 2024–Nov 2025) and holding them through the second year returned +32% to +51% depending on the semis pick, against +9.9% for the Nasdaq, so the selection method held up out of sample. A walk-forward test that rotated sector winners every quarter on price data alone returned slightly less than holding (+72% vs +74% from May 2025), which is why a swap must pass all four tests.
